note_on_verification: Every downloaded file was checked for byte count AND magic bytes. The PIC DESI mirror was OBSERVED to return HTTP 200 with a 21-byte 'Internal Server Error' body for both BGS_BRIGHT_NGC_nz.txt and BGS_BRIGHT_NGC_clustering.dat.fits on first attempt; the fetch loop retries until the published sha256 matches. Do not trust a 200 from this mirror without checking the sha256sum file.

B_desi_dr1_lss.SPEC_CORRECTION: There is NO v1/ directory in DESI DR1. LSScats/ contains exactly v1.2, v1.5 and v1.5pip. v1.5 is staged here (the DR1 fiducial LSS catalogue version).
B_desi_dr1_lss.PRIMARY_HOST_UNREACHABLE: data.desi.lbl.gov (and portal.nersc.gov) are NOT routable from this machine: DNS resolves to 128.55.206.106-113 but TCP 80 and 443 both return 'Network is unreachable', inside and outside the sandbox, on every resolved IP. Used the official European mirror at PIC instead.
B_desi_dr1_lss.mirror_note: WebDAV: GET on a directory returns HTTP 200 with an EMPTY body. Use PROPFIND with 'Depth: 1' to list.
B_desi_dr1_lss.DEFERRED: The 18-realisation randoms were NOT mirrored. Clustering randoms alone are 65.0 GiB and the full BGS_BRIGHT+LRG set is 764.2 GiB; the measured link here is ~0.5 MB/s aggregate. Every random file's direct URL, exact byte count and official sha256 are in the manifest and all were verified HTTP 200, so any subset can be pulled directly without re-discovery.

F_zenodo_15726063.role: VALIDATION ONLY - figure-level data from the DESI E_G paper. NOT primary data. Must never be used as an input catalogue; use it only to check a reproduction against published curves.
F_zenodo_15726063.title: Testing gravitational physics by combining spectroscopic and weak lensing datasets using the E_G estimator

C_des_y3.note: Fully public over plain HTTPS, no auth. All three verified as genuine HDF5 by range-read of bytes 0-15 (89 48 44 46 0d 0a 1a 0a). Not mirrored: 376 GB total, and every file exceeds the 2 GiB GitHub release-asset cap, so re-hosting is impossible without splitting.

D_hsc_s19a_pdr3.evidence: GET https://hsc-release.mtk.nao.ac.jp/archive/filetree/... -> HTTP 401 Unauthorized, header: www-authenticate: Basic realm="hsc-ssp". The documentation pages are public (HTTP 200) but EVERY data link on the S19A/Y3 shape-catalog page points into /archive/filetree/, which is uniformly 401.
D_hsc_s19a_pdr3.action_taken: None. No account created, no credentials entered, no access control bypassed.
D_hsc_s19a_pdr3.what_is_needed: An hsc-ssp account (free self-registration at https://hsc-release.mtk.nao.ac.jp/doc/ ) held by a human; the shape catalogue additionally requires accepting the HSC SSP data-use terms.
